QuestInfo.name: [Commerci Republic] The Problem with Presumptions
QuestInfo.0: You feel guilty from hiding the truth from Mayor Berry. Now that you have gained his trust, perhaps this is a good time to relay the Empress' message.
QuestInfo.2: You revealed your true mission and relayed the Empress' wishes for a peaceful relationship, but there was a big misunderstanding. You were supposed to be speaking with the leader of all Commerci.
